_comment: Prompts for tools/elevenlabs_sfx.py. One ElevenLabs take per entry; variants _2/_3 are made by DSP. Prompts describe sounds physically and never name any franchise. combat.* keys are manifest families of godot/assets/audio/combat; game.* are general sounds in godot/assets/audio/game.

wave_charge.prompt: Anime-style energy charging between cupped hands, deep rising electric hum with a bright glowing whine on top, crackling sparks, steady sustained power build, seamless loop

wave_release.prompt: Anime-style huge energy beam fired from both hands, powerful roaring blast with a bright sizzling whoosh, sustained rushing energy stream, cinematic

wave_impact.prompt: Massive energy beam slamming into a target, big deep explosion with rumbling boom, crackling energy debris and rolling tail

blast_charge.prompt: Small ball of energy humming in an open palm, compact buzzing electric glow with faint crackle, sustained, seamless loop

blast_release.prompt: Quick anime energy blast fired from the palm, short punchy zap with a fast whoosh, snappy

blast_impact.prompt: Small energy ball hitting a target, short sharp crackling pop explosion, tight and punchy

disc_charge.prompt: Spinning disc of energy held overhead, high-pitched whirring buzz-saw hum, steady rotating electric whine, seamless loop

disc_release.prompt: Spinning energy saw blade thrown through the air, whirring buzz-saw whoosh flying away, doppler sweep

disc_impact.prompt: Spinning energy blade slicing through rock, sharp metallic slicing shriek with crackling sparks and a short crunch

flare_charge.prompt: Bright light gathering around a face, shimmering rising high hum with glassy sparkle, sustained radiant tone, seamless loop

flare_release.prompt: Blinding flash of light burst, bright crystalline whoosh flare with a sharp shimmering pop, airy ringing

flare_impact.prompt: Dazzling light flash fading out, high bright ringing shimmer with soft airy sparkle tail

triad_charge.prompt: Energy concentrated in a triangle shape between hands, intense focused electric hum with a tense high whine and buzzing pulses, seamless loop

triad_release.prompt: Concentrated energy beam fired with force, sharp piercing zap into a heavy roaring beam blast

triad_impact.prompt: Focused energy beam striking the ground, deep crushing explosion with a cratering thud and crackle

rush_charge.prompt: Martial artist tensing up before a rushing attack, low rumbling wind and energy aura flickering, sustained, seamless loop

rush_release.prompt: Rapid martial arts flurry of claw strikes, fast whooshing swipes in quick succession with air cuts

rush_impact.prompt: Flurry of hard punches and claw strikes landing on a body, fast series of meaty thumps ending in a heavy hit

transform_charge.prompt: Warrior powering up, intense roaring energy aura building, rumbling earth, rising electric crackle, sustained, seamless loop

transform_release.prompt: Explosive power-up transformation burst, huge flaring energy aura erupting with a deep whoosh and electric crackle

transform_impact.prompt: Energy aura settling after a power-up, roaring flame-like aura with a deep pulsing hum fading out

spirit_charge.prompt: Giant energy sphere gathering overhead, vast deep swelling hum with a choir-like airy shimmer and slow rising power, seamless loop

spirit_release.prompt: Huge energy sphere thrown down from above, massive heavy rushing whoosh with a deep rumbling roar

spirit_impact.prompt: Gigantic energy sphere colliding and detonating, enormous deep explosion with long rumbling tail and debris

spiral_charge.prompt: Energy drilling at two fingertips, high whirling spiral whine with tight electric crackle, sustained, seamless loop

spiral_release.prompt: Corkscrew drilling energy beam fired, piercing spiraling zap with a high whirling scream

spiral_impact.prompt: Drilling energy beam piercing through a target, sharp boring screech ending in a concentrated explosion

lance_charge.prompt: Energy gathering at the forehead, dark tense buzzing hum with a menacing low drone and fizzing crackle, seamless loop

lance_release.prompt: Energy lance beam fired forward, sharp thrusting electric zap with a buzzing beam stream

lance_impact.prompt: Energy lance hitting a target, sharp sizzling burst explosion with crackle

galick_charge.prompt: Dark violet energy charging at the side of the body, deep menacing growling hum with thick electric crackle, seamless loop

galick_release.prompt: Dark powerful energy beam unleashed, heavy roaring blast with a gritty distorted energy stream

galick_impact.prompt: Dark energy beam exploding on impact, heavy booming detonation with gritty crackle and rumble

flash_charge.prompt: Enormous energy gathering in front of both palms, intense blazing rising roar with high electric sizzle, overwhelming power build, seamless loop

flash_release.prompt: Gigantic blazing energy wave fired, colossal roaring blast with searing sizzle and a long rushing stream

flash_impact.prompt: Colossal energy wave impact, gigantic explosion with deep shockwave and long rolling thunder rumble

heavy_charge.prompt: Large heavy energy ball growing in one hand, thick deep throbbing hum with pulsing rumble, seamless loop

heavy_release.prompt: Large heavy energy ball fired, deep thumping launch with a big rushing whoosh

heavy_impact.prompt: Large energy ball exploding, big heavy boom with shockwave and crumbling rock debris

needle_charge.prompt: Tiny concentrated energy point at a fingertip, thin high-pitched focused whine with faint fizz, seamless loop

needle_release.prompt: Thin precise energy laser shot from a fingertip, very quick sharp piercing zip zap

needle_impact.prompt: Thin laser piercing a target, tiny sharp sizzling pop

eclipse_charge.prompt: Dark ominous energy orb growing above a raised finger, deep sinister swelling drone with low throbbing pulse and distant thunder, seamless loop

eclipse_release.prompt: Huge dark energy orb descending, heavy ominous rushing roar with deep sub rumble

eclipse_impact.prompt: Massive dark energy orb detonating, apocalyptic deep explosion with long rumbling earthquake tail

heal_charge.prompt: Gentle healing energy glowing, warm soft shimmering pad with light sparkling chimes and calm breath, seamless loop

heal_release.prompt: Healing magic released, warm rising shimmer with soft sparkling chime swell

heal_impact.prompt: Healing complete, soft bright magical sparkle chime with a warm gentle glow fading out

sweet_charge.prompt: Playful pink magic charging, bubbly soft warbling hum with light twinkling sparkles, seamless loop

sweet_release.prompt: Playful magic ribbon beam fired, bouncy wobbly zap with sparkly twinkle

sweet_impact.prompt: Playful magic hitting a target, soft bubbly pop with sparkles and a cartoon poof

transfer_charge.prompt: Continuous steady focused humming energy tone with soft tingling shimmer and gentle airy flutter, constant level, no pauses, seamless loop

transfer_release.prompt: Instant teleport vanish, quick airy zip with a soft vacuum pop

transfer_impact.prompt: Instant teleport reappearing, quick reverse whoosh into a soft displaced-air thump

evade_charge.prompt: Continuous steady soft wind rushing around a fighter with a faint flickering energy shimmer, constant level, no pauses, seamless loop

evade_release.prompt: Super fast dodge leaving an afterimage, quick sharp whoosh with a faint flicker

evade_impact.prompt: Afterimage fading away, soft quick airy flutter whoosh

demon_charge.prompt: Wild unstable energy surging in open palms, aggressive crackling roar with distorted electric surges, seamless loop

demon_release.prompt: Wild bursting energy wave fired, aggressive explosive roar with crackling chaotic energy stream

demon_impact.prompt: Bursting energy wave hitting, violent crackling explosion with heavy boom

chime_charge.prompt: Two fighters synchronizing energy, harmonious shimmering hum with soft resonant chimes, sustained, seamless loop

chime_release.prompt: Synchronized energy merge, bright harmonious chime swell with a sparkling whoosh

chime_impact.prompt: Energy fusion completing, bright resonant bell-like flash with a warm shimmering tail

destroy_charge.prompt: Annihilating energy sphere forming in a palm, deep unstable warping hum with crackling distortion and dark rumble, seamless loop

destroy_release.prompt: Annihilation sphere released, heavy warping whoosh with deep pulsing distortion

destroy_impact.prompt: Annihilation sphere erasing everything, deep implosion with reverse suction then crackling disintegration and rumble

focus_charge.prompt: Calm controlled energy, quiet steady meditative hum with soft airy shimmer and slow breath, seamless loop

focus_release.prompt: Energy aura snapping into perfect focus, clean bright resonant whoosh with a soft shimmering ring

focus_impact.prompt: Calm silver energy aura pulse, soft resonant shimmer with a gentle airy swell fading out

avatar_charge.prompt: Colossal energy giant manifesting, huge deep resonant drone with rising ethereal shimmer and rumbling ground, seamless loop

avatar_release.prompt: Giant energy fist swinging down, massive heavy whoosh with deep ethereal roar

avatar_impact.prompt: Giant energy fist smashing the ground, enormous deep impact boom with shockwave and long rumble

shield_charge.prompt: Energy barrier humming around a body, steady electric force field hum with soft crackle, seamless loop

shield_release.prompt: Energy force field snapping up, bright electric shield activation whoosh with resonant hum

shield_impact.prompt: Attack hitting an energy shield, resonant electric deflection thump with crackle and ring

impact_charge.prompt: Fighter winding up a punch, low tense wind and tightening fists with faint energy hum, seamless loop

impact_release.prompt: Loud fast punch swinging through the air, sharp close-up whoosh swipe, martial arts fight sound effect

impact_impact.prompt: Loud hard punch hitting a body, close-up solid meaty thump with crisp slap and snap, action movie fight sound effect

impact_light.prompt: Light quick punch hitting a body, short punchy fleshy thwack, anime fight style

impact_heavy.prompt: Heavy powerful punch hitting a body, deep thudding crunch with a shockwave boom, anime fight style

kick.prompt: Strong kick landing on a body, sharp snappy thump with whoosh, martial arts fight

guard.prompt: Loud punch blocked by forearms, close-up solid thud with a short sharp crackling energy deflection, fight sound effect

swing.prompt: Fast martial arts swing through the air, quick sharp whoosh

landing.prompt: Loud heavy landing on rocky ground after a jump, close-up deep boot thud impact with dust burst and gravel scatter

flight.prompt: Fighter launching into flight, rushing wind whoosh with a soft energy aura roar

charge_loop.prompt: Fighter powering up energy aura, steady roaring flame-like aura with electric crackle and low rumble, sustained, seamless loop

ui_click.prompt: Clean short soft UI button click, subtle modern game menu tick

ui_confirm.prompt: Bright positive UI confirm sound, short two-tone soft chime, modern game menu

ui_back.prompt: Soft UI cancel or close sound, short descending muted blip, modern game menu

menu_open.prompt: Game menu panel opening, soft airy swoosh with a light glassy tick

level_up.prompt: Triumphant short level up sting, bright rising brass and shimmering chime swell, video game, original

quest_accept.prompt: New quest accepted, short adventurous rising two-note horn with soft paper rustle, video game

quest_complete.prompt: Quest complete, short heroic orchestral fanfare sting with brass and cymbal swell, original, video game

item_pickup.prompt: Picking up an item, short bright sparkly pop with a soft whoosh, video game

zeni.prompt: Handful of gold coins clinking, short bright coin jingle, video game currency pickup

boost_ignite.prompt: Energy aura igniting like a rocket booster, sudden roaring burst with rushing wind and crackle

travel_whoosh.prompt: High speed flight travel transition, long rushing wind whoosh passing by with a deep swoosh
